subject: eng
title: Grammar 2A Ch 4: Plural Nouns, Articles & Because

questions.q: What is the plural form of 'strawberry'?
questions.explain: strawberry 以「輔音 + y」結尾，眾數要改 y 為 ies（strawberries）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: What is the plural form of 'strawberry'?
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 4: Plural Nouns, Articles & Because

questions.q: What is the plural form of 'peach'?
questions.explain: peach 以 ch 結尾，眾數要加 -es（peaches）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: What is the plural form of 'peach'?
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 4: Plural Nouns, Articles & Because

questions.q: There are two ___ and an apple on the table.
questions.explain: two 後面用複數名詞，mango 的眾數加 -es（mangoes）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: There are two ___ and an apple on the table.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 4: Plural Nouns, Articles & Because

questions.q: I can see a bee and an ant. ___ bee is flying.
questions.explain: 第二次提到同一隻蜜蜂（bee）時，要用定冠詞 The。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: I can see a bee and an ant. ___ bee is flying.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 4: Plural Nouns, Articles & Because

questions.q: I don't like lemons ___ they are sour.
questions.explain: 解釋不喜歡檸檬的原因（they are sour），用連接詞 because（因為）。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: I don't like lemons ___ they are sour.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 4: Plural Nouns, Articles & Because

questions.q: Fill in the plural noun: Candy has fifteen ___ (cherry).
questions.explain: cherry 以輔音 r + y 結尾，去 y 加 ies 變成 cherries。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Fill in the plural noun: Candy has fifteen ___ (cherry).
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 4: Plural Nouns, Articles & Because

questions.q: Nouns ending in vowel + y (like 'boy', 'toy', 'monkey') just add -s in the plural form.
questions.explain: 元音 + y 結尾的名詞直接加 -s（boys, toys, monkeys），不改 ies。
questions.subject: eng
questions.question: Nouns ending in vowel + y (like 'boy', 'toy', 'monkey') just add -s in the plural form.
questions.source: 英文補充教材｜Grammar 2A Ch 4: Plural Nouns, Articles & Because

questions.q: Rearrange the words to form a correct sentence.
questions.explain: 主句 I like butterflies 加上原因子句 because they are beautiful。
